analysisSummary: AI evaluation reveals advanced proliferative diabetic retinopathy with prominent disc (NVD) and peripheral (NVE) neovascularization. Severe vascular tortuosity and proliferative fronds represent high-risk PDR requiring emergency vitreoretinal intervention to prevent blindness.
